description:
Project Name: Bly Road Janitorial Service

Solicitation No. 1240BF26Q0026

Project Location:

Freemont-Winema National Forest

Bly Compound

6100 HWY140 East

Bly, Oregon 97622

This synopsis publicizes a forthcoming solicitation for Janitorial Services at Bly Compound Freemont-Winema National Forest. As authorized by FAR 12.201-1 Simplified procedures (c) (2) the contracting officer has chosen to solicit quotations directly from suppliers.

If you believe you would be a good fit for this project, please email the following to Bridgette.Jones@usda.gov.

  1. Company Name
  2. UEI SAM number
  3. Point of Contact Name
  4. Phone number
  5. Email address
  6. *Property Services Contractor License from (BOLI)

* Any person or entity that recruits, solicits, supplies or employs workers for janitorial
services must have a valid Property Services Contractor License from the Oregon
Bureau of Labor & Industries (BOLI). The annual license fee is $350.00. See the following
website for directions on how to apply for a license.
https://www.oregon.gov/boli/employers/pages/property-services-janitorial-laborcontractors.
aspx

The estimated solicitation issue date is May 08, 2026

Quotations will be due around May 20, 2026

Quoters must be registered in www.Sam.gov by the quote due date.

The solicitation will not be posted to SAM. The solicitation will be solicited directly
to at least three sources.
